english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on frugal living and avoiding unnecessary spending or comfort.

examples.english: We need to live a more spartan lifestyle and stop buying things we don't need.
examples.traditional: 我哋而家要節儉啲，唔好成日買冇需要嘅嘢。
